question: Will the US 10-Year Treasury yield on August 25, 2026 be above 4.70%?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the US 10-Year Treasury constant maturity yield for August 25, 2026, as published in the Federal Reserve H.15 Statistical Release (series DGS10), is strictly greater than 4.70%.
- "No": Wins if the US 10-Year Treasury constant maturity yield for August 25, 2026, as published in the Federal Reserve H.15 Statistical Release (series DGS10), is 4.70% or below.

data_sources: Federal Reserve H.15 Selected Interest Rates
FRED DGS10 – Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity
